title: Human-AI Collaboration: From Paradoxes to Patterns
abstract: arXiv:2609.36481v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evidence shows that humans and AI systems perform better together, by collaborating, than alone. This paper examines two key design dimensions of human-AI collaboration (autonomy and initiative) and explores the collaboration patterns that they generate. Documenting these patterns starts with identifying the underlying problems and solutions, followed by examining the internal tensions within the problems. The paper uses a paradox perspective to analyze those tensions. It describes a process for surfacing the tensions and mapping the underlying paradoxes. It also illustrates how the pattern descriptions can be derived from mapping these paradoxes. Finally, the paper documents four human-AI collaboration patterns: Instruction, Delegation, Assistance, and Co-creation.

translated_title: 人机协作：从悖论到模式
translated_abstract: 有证据表明，人类与AI系统通过协作共同工作的表现优于各自单独工作。本文考察了人机协作的两个关键设计维度（自主性和主动性），并探讨了由它们产生的协作模式。记录这些模式始于识别底层的问题与解决方案，随后审视问题内部的张力。本文采用悖论视角来分析这些张力，描述了一个揭示张力并映射底层悖论的过程，并说明了如何从映射这些悖论中推导出模式描述。最后，本文记录了四种人机协作模式：指令、委派、辅助和共创。
tldr: 本文通过悖论视角分析人机协作中自主性与主动性两个设计维度的内在张力，提出了一套将张力映射为悖论并推导协作模式的方法，并总结出指令、委派、辅助和共创四种人机协作模式。
en_tdlr: This paper uses a paradox perspective to analyze the tensions in two key design dimensions (autonomy and initiative) of human-AI collaboration, derives collaboration patterns from mapping these paradoxes, and documents four patterns: Instruction, Delegation, Assistance, and Co-creation.
